238	    def _update_alpha(self, train_loss, val_loss, train_acc):
239	        if train_loss is None and train_acc is None:
240	            return
241	        signal = 0.0
242	        memorized = False
243	        if train_acc is not None and train_acc >= self.zero_acc_threshold:
244	            memorized = True
245	        elif train_loss is not None and train_loss < self.zero_loss_threshold:
246	            memorized = True
247	        if memorized:
248	            signal = 10.0
249	        elif val_loss is not None and train_loss is not None and train_loss > 1e-12:
250	            signal = max(0.0, (val_loss - train_loss) / train_loss)
251	        self._cached_alpha = self.alpha_init * math.exp(-self.kappa * signal)

253	    def _get_ramp_factor(self):
254	        step = self._global_step
255	        if step <= self.warmup_steps:
256	            return 0.0
257	        elapsed = step - self.warmup_steps
258	        return min(1.0, elapsed / self.warmup_ramp)

260	    def _get_effective_wd(self, base_wd):
261	        acc = self._cached_train_acc
262	        sigmoid_val = self._sigmoid(self.wd_scale, acc, self.wd_thresh)
263	        return base_wd * (1.0 + self.wd_ramp * sigmoid_val)

265	    def _get_gate_signal(self):

269	        if self._cached_train_acc < self.sam_enable_threshold:
270	            return 999999  # effectively disabled
271	        acc = self._cached_train_acc
272	        sam_heat = self._sigmoid(self.sam_scale, acc, self.sam_thresh)
273	        freq = self.sam_freq_max - (self.sam_freq_max - self.sam_freq_min) * sam_heat
274	        return max(1, round(freq))

277	        acc = self._cached_train_acc
278	        bilevel_heat = self._sigmoid(self.bilevel_scale, acc, self.bilevel_thresh)
279	        freq = self.bilevel_freq_max - (self.bilevel_freq_max - self.bilevel_freq_min) * bilevel_heat

283	    def step(self, closure=None, train_loss=None, val_loss=None, train_acc=None):
284	        """Eager optimiser step — REMOVED (pure L3-TC).
285	
286	        On the L3-TC path the SAM 2nd backward + per-tensor meta-net mu precompute +
287	        the SG15 apply run IN the megakernel; the meta-net is trained host-side via
288	        ``sam_step``/``bilevel_step`` (pure-PyTorch autograd, kept) and fused_train_
289	        step re-extracts its phi pack. The eager kernel dispatch here is gone
290	        (``_update_alpha`` / ``_get_gate_signal`` stay as host-side helpers)."""
291	        raise NotImplementedError(
292	            "L3-TC megakernel only; eager .step() removed — the megakernel owns "
293	            "the optimizer update via fused_train_step")

295	    def sam_step(self, model, train_x, train_y, criterion):
296	        """SAM ascent step → per-parameter sharpness |g(w+e) − g(w)|.
297	
298	        Recomputes the gradient at the SAM-perturbed point e(w)=rho·g/‖g‖ via
299	        ``torch.func.functional_call`` and stores the elementwise sharpness into
300	        ``_flat_sharpness`` — the buffer both ``bilevel_step`` and the fused
301	        kernel read as the meta-net's 2nd MLP input. Two correctness points the
302	        previous version got wrong (identical bug to supergrok11.sam_step):
303	          • the perturbed params are built from ``.detach()`` tensors, so they
304	            must be ``.requires_grad_(True)`` or autograd has nothing to
305	            differentiate (the old ``sam_loss.backward()`` raised
306	            "element 0 … does not require grad" every call → sharpness stayed at
307	            its zero init);
308	          • ``functional_call`` substitutes the perturbed tensors as the
309	            module's params, so gradients live on THEM, not on
310	            ``model.parameters().grad``. We take them with ``autograd.grad`` and
311	            leave each ``p.grad`` (the original backward result) untouched.
312	        """
313	        self._ensure_state()
314	        train_grads = {}
315	        for name, p in model.named_parameters():
316	            if p.grad is not None:
317	                train_grads[name] = p.grad.detach().clone()
318	        if not train_grads:
319	            return 0.0
320	
321	        # Compute perturbation direction without modifying actual params
322	        flat_grads = [train_grads[n] for n, _ in model.named_parameters() if n in train_grads]
323	        total_norm_sq = sum(g.norm().pow(2) for g in flat_grads if g.numel() > 0)
324	        grad_norm = total_norm_sq.sqrt() + 1e-12
325	        rho_over_norm = self.sam_rho / grad_norm
326	
327	        # Perturbed params must require grad so autograd.grad can differentiate
328	        # the SAM loss w.r.t. them (functional_call does NOT write into
329	        # model.parameters().grad).
330	        named_params = dict(model.named_parameters())
331	        pert_names = [n for n in named_params if n in train_grads]
332	        perturbed = {}
333	        for name, p in named_params.items():
334	            if name in train_grads:
335	                perturbed[name] = (p.detach() + rho_over_norm * train_grads[name]).requires_grad_(True)
336	            else:
337	                perturbed[name] = p.detach()
338	
339	        with torch.enable_grad():
340	            sam_logits = torch.func.functional_call(model, perturbed, (train_x,))
341	            sam_loss = criterion(sam_logits, train_y)
342	            sam_grads = torch.autograd.grad(
343	                sam_loss, [perturbed[n] for n in pert_names], allow_unused=True)
344	        sam_loss_val = sam_loss.item()
345	
346	        # sharpness = |sam_grad - normal_grad|, flattened to match the (numel,)
347	        # zero-init buffer the kernel reshapes
348	        for name, sg in zip(pert_names, sam_grads):
349	            if sg is None:
350	                continue
351	            pidx = self._param_to_idx.get(id(named_params[name]))
352	            if pidx is not None:
353	                self._flat_sharpness[pidx] = (sg.detach() - train_grads[name]).abs().reshape(-1)
354	
355	        return sam_loss_val
356	
357	    def bilevel_step(self, model, train_x, train_y, val_x, val_y, criterion, meta_optimizer):
358	        """Bilevel meta-net training — lookahead validation-descent objective.
359	
360	        Trains the meta-net so its smart gradient improves validation WITHOUT
361	        leaving the train manifold, one virtual step ahead:
362	        ``w⁺ = w·(1−lr·wd) − lr·meta_net(g, sharpness)``,
363	        ``meta_loss = val_CE(w⁺) + train_CE(w⁺)``, differentiated through the
364	        virtual step (``functional_call``; real params/grads untouched).
365	        Replaces the unbounded-alignment objective ``−Σ(smart_grad·vg_unit)``
366	        whose magnitude reward collapsed training once the train gradient
367	        vanished; the val-only lookahead variant nearly grokked (test 0.92)
368	        but oscillated and collapsed — the kernel re-applies the cached meta
369	        output every step between bilevel updates, overshooting the lookahead
370	        horizon. The train term anchors the train level-set, making the
371	        optimum "move along the manifold toward better val" (the grokking
372	        direction) and self-healing after slips. Same fix as
373	        SuperGrok11.meta_step — meta FULLY ACTIVE, no gating/suppression.
374	        Uses cached sharpness. Batched meta-net forward."""
375	        self._ensure_state()
376	        named_params = list(model.named_parameters())
377	
378	        saved_grads = {}
379	        for name, p in named_params:
380	            if p.grad is not None:
381	                saved_grads[name] = p.grad.detach().clone()
382	
383	        # Batched meta-net forward — one call instead of per-parameter
384	        all_grads = []
385	        all_sharps = []
386	        all_names = []
387	        all_sizes = []
388	        for name, p in named_params:
389	            if name in saved_grads:
390	                pidx = self._param_to_idx.get(id(p))
391	                all_grads.append(saved_grads[name].reshape(-1))
392	                all_sharps.append(
393	                    self._flat_sharpness[pidx].reshape(-1) if pidx is not None
394	                    else torch.zeros(p.data.numel(), device=p.device))
395	                all_names.append(name)
396	                all_sizes.append(saved_grads[name].numel())
397	
398	        smart_grads = {}
399	        if all_grads:
400	            cat_grads = torch.cat(all_grads)
401	            cat_sharps = torch.cat(all_sharps)
402	            cat_smart = self.meta_net(cat_grads, cat_sharps)
403	            offset = 0
404	            for name, size in zip(all_names, all_sizes):
405	                smart_grads[name] = cat_smart[offset:offset+size].reshape(saved_grads[name].shape)
406	                offset += size
407	
408	        # Virtual step at the optimizer's own lr/wd, evaluate val CE there;
409	        # gradients flow back through smart_grads into the meta-net only.
410	        group = self.param_groups[0]
411	        lr_eff = float(group["lr"])
412	        wd_eff = float(group.get("weight_decay", 0.0))
413	        virtual = {}
414	        for name, p in named_params:
415	            base = p.detach()
416	            if name in smart_grads:
417	                virtual[name] = base * (1.0 - lr_eff * wd_eff) - lr_eff * smart_grads[name]
418	            else:
419	                virtual[name] = base
420	
421	        meta_optimizer.zero_grad()
422	        with torch.enable_grad():
423	            val_loss = criterion(
424	                torch.func.functional_call(model, virtual, (val_x,)), val_y)
425	            meta_loss = val_loss + criterion(
426	                torch.func.functional_call(model, virtual, (train_x,)), train_y)
427	        meta_loss.backward()
428	        meta_optimizer.step()
429	        self._weights_dirty = True
430	
431	        for name, p in named_params:
432	            p.grad = saved_grads.get(name)
433	
434	        return val_loss.item()
435	
436	    def sam_meta_step(self, model, train_x, train_y, val_x, val_y, criterion, meta_optimizer):
437	        """Combined SAM + bilevel (backward-compatible)."""
438	        sam_loss = self.sam_step(model, train_x, train_y, criterion)
439	        val_loss = self.bilevel_step(model, train_x, train_y, val_x, val_y, criterion, meta_optimizer)
440	        return sam_loss, val_loss
441	
442	    def _single_param_step(self, param, group, state):
443	        """Per-parameter eager step (use_grad_hooks path) — REMOVED (pure L3-TC)."""
444	        raise NotImplementedError(
445	            "L3-TC megakernel only; eager .step() removed — the megakernel owns "
446	            "the optimizer update via fused_train_step")
447	
448	    def get_global_step(self):
449	        return self._global_step
450	
451	    def get_cached_alpha(self):
452	        return self._cached_alpha
453	
454	    def get_effective_wd(self):
455	        if self.param_groups:
456	            return self._get_effective_wd(self.param_groups[0]["weight_decay"])
457	        return 0.0
458	
459	    # ── Checkpoint fidelity (same contract as SuperGrok11) ──────────────────
460	    # All evolving state lives outside base Optimizer.state (flat Adam moments,
461	    # mu/sharpness meta inputs, per-param step counters, the trained meta-net,
462	    # the step_full-internal meta Adam). Serialize it or a resume silently
463	    # resets momentum AND the meta-net. Derived constants (_flat_layer_*) are
464	    # rebuilt by __init__ and not serialized.
465	    _EXTRA_KEY = "supergrok15_extra"
466	
467	    def state_dict(self):
468	        sd = super().state_dict()
469	        self._ensure_state()
470	        sd[self._EXTRA_KEY] = {
471	            "global_step": self._global_step,
472	            "cached_alpha": self._cached_alpha,
473	            "cached_train_acc": self._cached_train_acc,
474	            "flat_steps": list(self._flat_steps),
475	            "flat_exp_avgs": [t.detach().clone() for t in self._flat_exp_avgs],
476	            "flat_exp_avg_sqs": [t.detach().clone() for t in self._flat_exp_avg_sqs],
477	            "flat_mus": [t.detach().clone() for t in self._flat_mus],
478	            "flat_sharpness": [t.detach().clone() for t in self._flat_sharpness],
479	            "meta_net": self.meta_net.state_dict(),
480	        }
481	        if hasattr(self, "_auto_meta_opt"):
482	            sd[self._EXTRA_KEY]["auto_meta_opt"] = self._auto_meta_opt.state_dict()
483	        return sd
484	
485	    def load_state_dict(self, state_dict):
486	        extra = state_dict.get(self._EXTRA_KEY)
487	        base = {k: v for k, v in state_dict.items() if k != self._EXTRA_KEY}
488	        super().load_state_dict(base)
489	        if extra is None:
490	            return  # plain/base checkpoint: behave like the base class
491	        self._ensure_state()
492	        n = len(self._flat_params)
493	        for key in ("flat_exp_avgs", "flat_exp_avg_sqs", "flat_mus",
494	                    "flat_sharpness"):
495	            saved = extra[key]
496	            live = getattr(self, "_" + key)
497	            if len(saved) != n:
498	                raise ValueError(
499	                    f"SuperGrok15.load_state_dict: checkpoint has {len(saved)} "
500	                    f"{key} buffers but the optimizer holds {n} params — "
501	                    f"the model architecture changed.")
502	            for dst, src in zip(live, saved):
503	                if dst.numel() != src.numel():
504	                    raise ValueError(
505	                        f"SuperGrok15.load_state_dict: {key} numel mismatch "
506	                        f"({dst.numel()} vs checkpoint {src.numel()}).")
507	                dst.copy_(src.to(dst.device, dtype=dst.dtype))
508	        self._flat_steps = list(extra["flat_steps"])
509	        self._global_step = int(extra["global_step"])
510	        self._cached_alpha = float(extra["cached_alpha"])
511	        self._cached_train_acc = float(extra["cached_train_acc"])
512	        self.meta_net.load_state_dict(extra["meta_net"])
513	        if "auto_meta_opt" in extra:
514	            if not hasattr(self, "_auto_meta_opt"):
515	                self._auto_meta_opt = torch.optim.Adam(
516	                    self.meta_net.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
517	            self._auto_meta_opt.load_state_dict(extra["auto_meta_opt"])
518	        self._weights_dirty = True   # re-extract kernel weights from the loaded net
519	
520	    def step_full(self, model, train_x, train_y, val_x, val_y, criterion=None):
521	        """Complete training step: forward + backward + SAM + meta-learning + optimizer."""
522	        if criterion is None:
523	            criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
524	        if not hasattr(self, '_auto_meta_opt'):
525	            self._auto_meta_opt = torch.optim.Adam(self.meta_net.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
526	
527	        model.zero_grad()
528	        logits = model(train_x)
529	        loss = criterion(logits, train_y)
530	        loss.backward()
531	
532	        metrics: Dict[str, float] = {}
533	        step_num = self._global_step + 1
534	
535	        sam_freq_eff = self._get_effective_sam_freq()
536	        if step_num % sam_freq_eff == 0:
537	            try:
538	                metrics["sam_loss"] = self.sam_step(model, train_x, train_y, criterion)
539	            except Exception as e:
540	                import warnings
541	                warnings.warn(f"SuperGrok1.5 sam_step failed at step {step_num}: {e}")
542	
543	        bilevel_freq_eff = self._get_effective_bilevel_freq()
544	        if step_num % bilevel_freq_eff == 0:
545	            try:
546	                metrics["val_loss"] = self.bilevel_step(
547	                    model, train_x, train_y, val_x, val_y, criterion, self._auto_meta_opt)
548	            except Exception as e:
549	                import warnings
550	                warnings.warn(f"SuperGrok1.5 bilevel_step failed at step {step_num}: {e}")
551	
552	        kw: Dict[str, float] = {}
553	        alpha_freq = self.alpha_update_freq
554	        if (step_num % alpha_freq == 0) or step_num == 1:
555	            with torch.no_grad():
556	                train_loss_val = loss.item()
557	                train_acc = (logits.detach().argmax(-1) == train_y).float().mean().item()
558	            kw["train_loss"] = train_loss_val
559	            kw["train_acc"] = train_acc
560	            metrics["train_loss"] = train_loss_val
561	            metrics["train_acc"] = train_acc
562	            if step_num % alpha_freq == 0:
563	                with torch.no_grad():
564	                    val_loss_val = criterion(model(val_x), val_y).item()
565	                kw["val_loss"] = val_loss_val
566	                if "val_loss" not in metrics:
567	                    metrics["val_loss"] = val_loss_val
568	
569	        self.step(**kw)
570	        return metrics
571	
572	
573	# ── Shared (inlined) helper: register post_accumulate_grad_hook on each param.
574	# Each hook calls back into the optimizer's `_single_param_step` so the update
575	# runs while gradient data is still L2-warm. Duplicated across every optimizer
576	# file by design (self-containment); requires PyTorch >= 2.1.
577	def _register_grad_hooks(optimizer):
578	    # Fail-fast (construction time): the per-parameter eager `_single_param_step`
579	    # was removed under pure L3-TC (the megakernel owns the optimizer update via
580	    # fused_train_step), so the grad-hook path cannot run. Raise HERE — when the
581	    # optimizer is constructed with use_grad_hooks=True — rather than mid-backward
582	    # from inside the hook, so `--grad-hooks` fails immediately with a clear
583	    # message. The plumbing below is retained for when an eager path returns.
584	    raise NotImplementedError(
585	        "use_grad_hooks is not supported: the per-parameter eager step was "
586	        "removed under pure L3-TC (the megakernel owns the optimizer update via "
587	        "fused_train_step). Construct the optimizer with use_grad_hooks=False "
588	        "(the default) and drive training through the fused L3-TC megakernel.")
589	    _pt = tuple(int(x) for x in torch.__version__.split("+")[0].split(".")[:2])
590	    if _pt < (2, 1):
591	        raise RuntimeError(
592	            f"use_grad_hooks requires PyTorch >= 2.1 for "
593	            f"register_post_accumulate_grad_hook. Current: {torch.__version__}.")
594	    optimizer._grad_hook_handles = []
595	    for group in optimizer.param_groups:
596	        for p in group["params"]:
597	            if not p.requires_grad:
598	                continue
599	            def _hook(param, _g=group, _opt=optimizer):
600	                if param.grad is None:
601	                    return
602	                _opt._single_param_step(param, _g, _opt.state[param])
603	            optimizer._grad_hook_handles.append(
604	                p.register_post_accumulate_grad_hook(_hook))

1	"""
2	SuperGrok v2 — CSA/HCA Hybrid Attention + 4-Head PEER + GRU Meta-Net Optimizer
3	
4	Replaces the previous Mamba-3 bidirectional selective-scan SEQUENCE MIXER with a
5	DeepSeek-V4-style CSA/HCA hybrid compressed attention stack. The GRU + PEER
6	product-key routing + per-element expert MLP + Adam apply tail are kept verbatim
7	(per spec §3b — the tail is independent of the sequence mixer).
8	
9	The meta-model is sequence→sequence (N gradient elements → N smart values). The
10	two attention contexts replace the two scan outputs one-for-one (same shapes):
11	
12	  - CSA (Compressed Sparse Attention, m=4, sliding window=8, top-k):
13	      compresses KV by strided weighted pooling, uses a low-rank "lightning
14	      indexer" to pick top-k compressed entries per query, plus a causal sliding
15	      window of raw tokens, then multi-head softmax attention. Produces
16	      ``csa_ctx`` — the fine-grained/local context (was ``mamba_fwd`` output).
17	  - HCA (Heavily Compressed Attention, m'=128, dense):
18	      mean-pools KV at stride 128, dense attention over ALL compressed entries
19	      plus the sliding window. Produces ``hca_ctx`` — the global coarse context
20	      (was ``mamba_bwd`` output).
21	
22	Key features:
23	  - CSA + HCA hybrid attention sequence mixer (sorted by |gradient| magnitude)
24	  - 4-Head PEER product-key expert routing (144 experts, 4 active per element)
25	  - Per-element GRU for temporal gradient memory (carried across steps)
26	  - Dynamic expert recycling (dead experts cloned from top performer)
27	  - All adaptive scheduling from v1.5 (sigmoid SAM/bilevel/WD, alpha updates)
28	  - functional_call SAM (no parameter modification)
29	  - CUDA-only execution path (no Python reference fallback)
30	
31	Notes:
32	  - Attention is STATELESS across optimizer steps (unlike Mamba's carried scan
33	    state). The GRU state is still carried across steps.
34	  - All meta-model accumulation is FP32.
35	"""
36	
37	import math
38	import warnings
39	import torch
40	import torch.nn as nn
41	import torch.distributed as dist
42	from torch.optim import Optimizer
43	from torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint as _grad_checkpoint
44	from typing import Optional, Dict, List, Tuple
45	
46	
47	# Activation/gradient checkpointing helper (mirrors grokking_race_v2.py).
48	# Only checkpoints when training AND grad is being tracked — under
49	# torch.no_grad()/eval there is nothing to recompute, so we call directly,
50	# avoiding checkpoint's overhead and its "no input requires grad" warning.
51	# This keeps the eval/inference and CUDA fused-step paths completely unaffected.
52	def _maybe_checkpoint(module, x, enabled):
53	    """Run ``module(x)`` (single-tensor input), optionally checkpointed."""
54	    if enabled and module.training and torch.is_grad_enabled():
55	        return _grad_checkpoint(module, x, use_reentrant=False)
56	    return module(x)
57	
58	
59	def _maybe_checkpoint_fn(fn, enabled, training, *args):
60	    """Run ``fn(*args)`` for an arbitrary self-contained sub-computation,
61	    optionally under activation checkpointing.
62	
63	    Used for the in-forward sub-blocks that are not standalone nn.Modules
64	    (per-stage attention closures, PEER expert MLP). ``training`` is the
65	    owning module's ``self.training`` flag so eval bypasses recomputation.
66	    """
67	    if enabled and training and torch.is_grad_enabled():
68	        return _grad_checkpoint(fn, *args, use_reentrant=False)
69	    return fn(*args)
70	
71	from grokking_optimizers.dispatch import get_ops
72	from grokking_optimizers.dispatch import (
73	    get_device_sm, get_gpu_vendor,
74	    supports_bf16, supports_fp8, supports_tf32,
75	)

78	# The C++ pybind registers BOTH the new CSA/HCA names and the old mamba_peer
79	# aliases (same underlying fn) for back-compat. Detect either.

87	    fn = getattr(_ops, new_name, None)

89	        fn = getattr(_ops, old_name)

93	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
94	#  Precision configuration (formerly grokking_optimizers/_quantization.py)
95	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
96	
97	
98	class PrecisionConfig:
99	    """Configures precision for different components of the optimizer.
100	
101	    Supported precision modes (3-arch active set):
102	      Projections: fp32, tf32, bf16, fp8
103	      Expert weights: fp32, int8, int4
104	      Scan state: always fp32 (numerical necessity)
105	    """
106	
107	    PROJECTION_MODES = ('fp32', 'tf32', 'bf16', 'fp8', 'auto')
108	    EXPERT_MODES = ('fp32', 'int8', 'int4', 'auto')
109	
110	    def __init__(
111	        self,
112	        projection_precision='auto',
113	        expert_precision='fp32',
114	        scan_precision='fp32',
115	        dynamic=False,
116	    ):
117	        self.scan_precision = 'fp32'
118	        self.dynamic = dynamic
119	
120	        if projection_precision == 'auto':
121	            # 'auto' picks the live default: BF16 everywhere it is supported
122	            # (the configured default for SG2 — see SuperGrok2.__init__), only
123	            # dropping to FP32 on a host with no BF16 path. FP8/INT4 are NOT
124	            # selected by 'auto'; they remain explicitly opt-in (config-gated)
125	            # because they need the matching kernel ABI to be the live tail.
126	            vendor = get_gpu_vendor()  # noqa: F841 — kept for clarity/symmetry
127	            self.projection_precision = 'bf16' if supports_bf16() else 'fp32'
128	        else:
129	            if projection_precision not in self.PROJECTION_MODES:
130	                raise ValueError(
131	                    f"Unknown projection precision: {projection_precision}. "
132	                    f"Must be one of {self.PROJECTION_MODES}"
133	                )
134	            self.projection_precision = projection_precision
135	
136	        if expert_precision == 'auto':
137	            self.expert_precision = 'int8'
138	        else:
139	            if expert_precision not in self.EXPERT_MODES:
140	                raise ValueError(
141	                    f"Unknown expert precision: {expert_precision}. "
142	                    f"Must be one of {self.EXPERT_MODES}"
143	                )
144	            self.expert_precision = expert_precision
145	
146	        self._step_count = 0
147	        self._grad_norm_ema = None
148	        self._grad_norm_var_ema = None
149	        self._precision_tier = 0
150	
151	    def convert_projection_weights(self, w):
152	        """Convert a projection weight matrix to the target precision."""
153	        if self.projection_precision in ('fp32', 'tf32'):
154	            return w.float().contiguous(), None
155	        elif self.projection_precision == 'bf16':
156	            if not supports_bf16():
157	                return w.float().contiguous(), None
158	            return w.bfloat16().contiguous(), None
159	        elif self.projection_precision == 'fp8':
160	            if not supports_fp8():
161	                if supports_bf16():
162	                    return w.bfloat16().contiguous(), None
163	                return w.float().contiguous(), None
164	            scale = w.abs().max().clamp(min=1e-12)
165	            w_scaled = w.float().div(scale)
166	            w_fp8 = w_scaled.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
167	            return w_fp8, scale
168	        else:
169	            raise ValueError(f"Unknown precision: {self.projection_precision}")
170	
171	    def convert_expert_weights(self, w1, b1, w2, b2):
172	        """Convert expert MLP weights to target precision."""
173	        if self.expert_precision == 'fp32':
174	            return {
175	                'w1': w1.float().contiguous(),
176	                'b1': b1.float().contiguous(),
177	                'w2': w2.float().contiguous(),
178	                'b2': b2.float().contiguous(),
179	                'mode': 'fp32',
180	            }
181	        elif self.expert_precision == 'int8':
182	            return self._quantize_expert_int8(w1, b1, w2, b2)
183	        elif self.expert_precision == 'int4':
184	            return self._quantize_expert_int4(w1, b1, w2, b2)
185	        else:
186	            raise ValueError(f"Unknown expert precision: {self.expert_precision}")
187	
188	    def _quantize_expert_int8(self, w1, b1, w2, b2):
189	        def sym_quant(w):
190	            absmax = w.abs().max().clamp(min=1e-12)
191	            scale = absmax / 127.0
192	            q = (w / scale).round().clamp(-127, 127).to(torch.int8)
193	            return q, scale
194	
195	        w1_q, w1_s = sym_quant(w1.float())
196	        w2_q, w2_s = sym_quant(w2.float())
197	        return {
198	            'w1_q': w1_q.contiguous(), 'w1_s': w1_s,
199	            'b1': b1.float().contiguous(),
200	            'w2_q': w2_q.contiguous(), 'w2_s': w2_s,
201	            'b2': b2.float().contiguous(),
202	            'mode': 'int8',
203	        }
204	
205	    def _quantize_expert_int4(self, w1, b1, w2, b2):
206	        def int4_quant(w, group_size=32):
207	            w_flat = w.reshape(-1).float()
208	            N = w_flat.numel()
209	            N_padded = ((N + 1) // 2) * 2
210	            if N_padded > N:
211	                w_flat = torch.nn.functional.pad(w_flat, (0, N_padded - N))
212	
213	            num_groups = (N_padded + group_size - 1) // group_size
214	            actual_gs = N_padded // num_groups
215	            w_grouped = w_flat.reshape(num_groups, actual_gs)
216	
217	            gmax = w_grouped.max(dim=1).values
218	            gmin = w_grouped.min(dim=1).values
219	            scales = ((gmax - gmin) / 15.0).clamp(min=1e-12)
220	            zeros = gmin
221	
222	            q = ((w_grouped - zeros.unsqueeze(1)) / scales.unsqueeze(1))
223	            q = q.round().clamp(0, 15).to(torch.uint8).reshape(-1)
224	
225	            even = q[0::2]
226	            odd = q[1::2]
227	            packed = even | (odd << 4)
228	            return packed, scales, zeros
229	
230	        w1_p, w1_s, w1_z = int4_quant(w1)
231	        w2_p, w2_s, w2_z = int4_quant(w2)
232	        return {
233	            'w1_packed': w1_p.contiguous(), 'w1_scales': w1_s, 'w1_zeros': w1_z,
234	            'b1': b1.float().contiguous(),
235	            'w2_packed': w2_p.contiguous(), 'w2_scales': w2_s, 'w2_zeros': w2_z,
236	            'b2': b2.float().contiguous(),
237	            'mode': 'int4',
238	        }
239	
240	    def update_dynamic(self, grad_norm):
241	        """Update dynamic precision state based on gradient norm stability."""
242	        if not self.dynamic:
243	            return False
244	
245	        self._step_count += 1
246	        alpha = 0.01
247	
248	        if self._grad_norm_ema is None:
249	            self._grad_norm_ema = grad_norm
250	            self._grad_norm_var_ema = 0.0
251	            return False
252	
253	        self._grad_norm_ema = (1 - alpha) * self._grad_norm_ema + alpha * grad_norm
254	        deviation = (grad_norm - self._grad_norm_ema) ** 2
255	        self._grad_norm_var_ema = (1 - alpha) * self._grad_norm_var_ema + alpha * deviation
256	
257	        cv = math.sqrt(self._grad_norm_var_ema) / max(self._grad_norm_ema, 1e-12)
258	
259	        if self._step_count < 500:
260	            return False
261	
262	        changed = False
263	        if cv < 0.05 and self._precision_tier < 3:
264	            self._precision_tier = 3
265	            changed = True
266	        elif cv < 0.10 and self._precision_tier < 2:
267	            self._precision_tier = 2
268	            changed = True
269	        elif cv < 0.20 and self._precision_tier < 1:
270	            self._precision_tier = 1
271	            changed = True
272	        elif cv > 0.30 and self._precision_tier > 0:
273	            self._precision_tier = 0
274	            changed = True
275	
276	        if changed:
277	            self._apply_dynamic_tier()
278	        return changed
279	
280	    def _apply_dynamic_tier(self):
281	        vendor = get_gpu_vendor()
282	        if vendor == 'nvidia':
283	            proj_tiers = ['fp32', 'tf32', 'bf16', 'fp8']
284	        else:
285	            proj_tiers = ['fp32', 'fp32', 'bf16', 'bf16']
286	        expert_tiers = ['fp32', 'fp32', 'int8', 'int4']
287	
288	        tier = min(self._precision_tier, len(proj_tiers) - 1)
289	        new_proj = proj_tiers[tier]
290	        if new_proj == 'fp8' and not supports_fp8():
291	            new_proj = 'bf16'
292	        if new_proj == 'bf16' and not supports_bf16():
293	            new_proj = 'fp32'
294	        if new_proj == 'tf32' and not supports_tf32():
295	            new_proj = 'fp32'
296	        self.projection_precision = new_proj
297	        self.expert_precision = expert_tiers[min(tier, len(expert_tiers) - 1)]
298	
299	    @property
300	    def stability_cv(self):
301	        if self._grad_norm_ema is None or self._grad_norm_var_ema is None:
302	            return float('inf')
303	        return math.sqrt(self._grad_norm_var_ema) / max(self._grad_norm_ema, 1e-12)
304	
305	    def __repr__(self):
306	        parts = [
307	            f"projection={self.projection_precision}",
308	            f"expert={self.expert_precision}",
309	            f"scan={self.scan_precision}",
310	        ]
311	        if self.dynamic:
312	            parts.append(f"dynamic=True (tier={self._precision_tier})")
313	        return f"PrecisionConfig({', '.join(parts)})"

317	#  CSA/HCA Hybrid Attention + 4-Head PEER + GRU meta-network
318	#  (formerly grokking_optimizers/_metanet.py)
319	#
320	#  Architecture per optimizer step, per parameter:
321	#    1. SORT by |gradient|
322	#    2. CSA + HCA HYBRID ATTENTION — cross-element awareness via compressed
323	#       sparse (local/fine) + heavily-compressed dense (global/coarse) attention
324	#    3. PER-ELEMENT GRU — temporal memory across optimizer steps
325	#    4. 4-HEAD PEER ROUTING — product-key lookup, 4 experts per element
326	#    5. EXPERT MLP — 144 experts, hidden=16 default
327	#    6. DYNAMIC EXPERT RECYCLING — dead experts cloned from top performer
328	#    7. SKIP CONNECTION — smart_grad = grad + rescale * sum(expert_outputs)
329	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

332	class HybridCompressedAttention(nn.Module):
333	    """DeepSeek-V4-style compressed attention sequence mixer.
334	
335	    A single block instantiated twice (``mode='csa'`` and ``mode='hca'``) to
336	    produce the two context streams that replace the bidirectional Mamba scan.
337	
338	    mode='csa' — Compressed Sparse Attention (compression ``csa_compress``=4):
339	      1. KV compression: each compressed entry pools a window of ``csa_window``=8
340	         tokens at stride ``csa_compress``=4 with a learned per-position weight
341	         (softmax over ``csa_compress_w``).  Compressed length Nc = ceil(N/4).
342	      2. Lightning indexer (top-k): a low-rank query ``qI = x @ idx_DQ @ idx_UQ``
343	         (rank ``indexer_rank``=4) scores each query token against compressed
344	         indexer keys ``kI`` (pooled ``x @ idx_K``). Keep the top-k
345	         (``csa_topk``=16, clamped to Nc) highest-scoring compressed entries.
346	      3. Sliding window: additionally attend to the last ``csa_window`` raw
347	         tokens (causal local context).
348	      4. Attention: multi-head softmax(Q·Kᵀ/sqrt(head_dim))·V over the union of
349	         the selected compressed entries and the window. Output → ``out_W``.
350	
351	    mode='hca' — Heavily Compressed Attention (compression ``hca_compress``=128):
352	      1. KV compression: mean pool of ``hca_compress`` tokens at stride 128.
353	         Compressed length Nh = ceil(N/128).
354	      2. Dense attention: every query attends to ALL Nh compressed entries (no
355	         top-k) plus the sliding window. Global coarse context.
356	
357	    Compute is FP32. Output shape is [N, d_model] (== input feature width).
358	    Attention is stateless across optimizer steps.
359	    """
360	
361	    def __init__(
362	        self,
363	        d_model: int = 8,
364	        mode: str = 'csa',
365	        num_heads: int = 2,
366	        csa_compress: int = 4,
367	        csa_window: int = 8,
368	        csa_topk: int = 16,
369	        hca_compress: int = 128,
370	        indexer_rank: int = 4,
371	        grad_checkpoint: bool = True,
372	    ):
373	        super().__init__()
374	        assert mode in ('csa', 'hca'), f"mode must be 'csa' or 'hca', got {mode}"
375	        self.grad_checkpoint = grad_checkpoint
376	        assert d_model % num_heads == 0, \
377	            f"d_model ({d_model}) must be divisible by num_heads ({num_heads})"
378	        self.d_model = d_model
379	        self.mode = mode
380	        self.num_heads = num_heads
381	        self.head_dim = d_model // num_heads
382	        self.csa_compress = csa_compress
383	        self.csa_window = csa_window
384	        self.csa_topk = csa_topk
385	        self.hca_compress = hca_compress
386	        self.indexer_rank = indexer_rank
387	
388	        # Q/K/V projections (multi-query: KV shared across heads, packed [d,d]).
389	        self.q_W = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model, bias=False)
390	        self.k_W = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model, bias=False)
391	        self.v_W = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model, bias=False)
392	        self.out_W = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model, bias=False)
393	
394	        if mode == 'csa':
395	            # Learned pooling weights over the compression window.
396	            self.compress_w = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(csa_window))
397	            # Lightning indexer: low-rank query + key projection.
398	            self.idx_DQ = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(d_model, indexer_rank) * 0.02)
399	            self.idx_UQ = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(indexer_rank, d_model) * 0.02)
400	            self.idx_K = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(d_model, indexer_rank) * 0.02)
401	        else:
402	            # HCA registers no compress_w / indexer params (mean pool, dense).
403	            self.register_parameter('compress_w', None)
404	            self.register_parameter('idx_DQ', None)
405	            self.register_parameter('idx_UQ', None)
406	            self.register_parameter('idx_K', None)
407	
408	    def _split_heads(self, t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
409	        # [L, d_model] -> [num_heads, L, head_dim]
410	        L = t.shape[0]
411	        return t.reshape(L, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(1, 0, 2)
412	
413	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
414	        """x: [N, d_model] (|g|-sorted) → ctx: [N, d_model]. Stateless."""
415	        x = x.float()
416	        N, d = x.shape
417	        if N == 0:
418	            return torch.zeros(0, d, device=x.device, dtype=torch.float32)
419	
420	        scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
421	
422	        # Per-token projections.
423	        q = self.q_W(x)                       # [N, d]
424	        k_tok = self.k_W(x)                   # [N, d]
425	        v_tok = self.v_W(x)                   # [N, d]
426	
427	        # The heavy attention body (compression + indexer + scores + softmax)
428	        # is wrapped as a self-contained closure so it can be recomputed in the
429	        # backward pass instead of being held in memory. Output is the
430	        # pre-out_W context [N, d].
431	        def _csa_body(x, q, k_tok, v_tok):
432	            stride = self.csa_compress
433	            win = self.csa_window
434	            # ── Strided weighted pooling of K/V into compressed entries ──
435	            # Compressed entry j pools x[j*stride : j*stride+win].
436	            nc = (N + stride - 1) // stride   # ceil(N / stride)
437	            pool_w = torch.softmax(self.compress_w, dim=0)  # [win]
438	            starts = torch.arange(nc, device=x.device) * stride       # [Nc]
439	            offs = torch.arange(win, device=x.device)                 # [win]
440	            gather = starts.unsqueeze(1) + offs.unsqueeze(0)          # [Nc, win]
441	            valid = gather < N                                        # [Nc, win]
442	            gather_c = gather.clamp(max=N - 1)
443	            w_eff = pool_w.unsqueeze(0) * valid.float()               # [Nc, win]
444	            w_eff = w_eff / w_eff.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-12)
445	            # Pool compressed K/V.
446	            c_k = (k_tok[gather_c] * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)  # [Nc, d]
447	            c_v = (v_tok[gather_c] * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)  # [Nc, d]
448	
449	            # ── Lightning indexer top-k selection ──
450	            qI = (x @ self.idx_DQ) @ self.idx_UQ                      # [N, d]
451	            kI_tok = x @ self.idx_K @ self.idx_UQ                     # [N, d]
452	            c_kI = (kI_tok[gather_c] * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)  # [Nc, d]
453	            idx_scores = (qI @ c_kI.T) / math.sqrt(d)                 # [N, Nc]
454	            topk = min(self.csa_topk, nc)
455	            _, sel = idx_scores.topk(topk, dim=-1)                    # [N, topk]
456	
457	            # Gather selected compressed K/V per query → [N, topk, d].
458	            sel_k = c_k[sel]
459	            sel_v = c_v[sel]
460	            sel_kh = sel_k.reshape(N, topk, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
461	            sel_vh = sel_v.reshape(N, topk, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
462	            qh = q.reshape(N, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)          # [N, H, hd]
463	            # Scores over selected compressed entries: [N, H, topk]
464	            comp_scores = torch.einsum('nhd,nkhd->nhk', qh, sel_kh) * scale
465	
466	            # ── Causal sliding window over raw tokens ──
467	            wsz = min(win, N)
468	            woffs = torch.arange(wsz, device=x.device)               # [wsz]
469	            qpos = torch.arange(N, device=x.device).unsqueeze(1)     # [N, 1]
470	            win_idx = qpos - woffs.unsqueeze(0)                      # [N, wsz]
471	            win_valid = win_idx >= 0                                  # [N, wsz]
472	            win_idx_c = win_idx.clamp(min=0)
473	            win_k = k_tok[win_idx_c].reshape(N, wsz, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
474	            win_v = v_tok[win_idx_c].reshape(N, wsz, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
475	            win_scores = torch.einsum('nhd,nwhd->nhw', qh, win_k) * scale
476	            win_scores = win_scores.masked_fill(
477	                ~win_valid.unsqueeze(1), float('-inf'))
478	
479	            # ── Joint softmax over (selected compressed ∪ window) ──
480	            all_scores = torch.cat([comp_scores, win_scores], dim=-1)  # [N,H,topk+wsz]
481	            attn = torch.softmax(all_scores, dim=-1)
482	            attn_c = attn[:, :, :topk]                                # [N, H, topk]
483	            attn_w = attn[:, :, topk:]                                # [N, H, wsz]
484	            ctx_h = (torch.einsum('nhk,nkhd->nhd', attn_c, sel_vh)
485	                     + torch.einsum('nhw,nwhd->nhd', attn_w, win_v))  # [N, H, hd]
486	            ctx = ctx_h.reshape(N, d)
487	            return ctx
488	
489	        def _hca_body(x, q, k_tok, v_tok):
490	            # ── HCA: stride-128 mean pool, dense attention over all entries ──
491	            stride = self.hca_compress
492	            nh = (N + stride - 1) // stride
493	            starts = torch.arange(nh, device=x.device) * stride       # [Nh]
494	            offs = torch.arange(stride, device=x.device)              # [stride]
495	            gather = starts.unsqueeze(1) + offs.unsqueeze(0)          # [Nh, stride]
496	            valid = gather < N
497	            gather_c = gather.clamp(max=N - 1)
498	            w_eff = valid.float()
499	            w_eff = w_eff / w_eff.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-12)
500	            c_k = (k_tok[gather_c] * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)  # [Nh, d]
501	            c_v = (v_tok[gather_c] * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)  # [Nh, d]
502	
503	            qh = self._split_heads(q)                                # [H, N, hd]
504	            c_kh = self._split_heads(c_k)                            # [H, Nh, hd]
505	            c_vh = self._split_heads(c_v)                            # [H, Nh, hd]
506	            # Dense scores over all compressed entries: [H, N, Nh]
507	            comp_scores = torch.einsum('hnd,hmd->hnm', qh, c_kh) * scale
508	
509	            # Causal sliding window (reuse csa_window size for local context).
510	            win = min(self.csa_window, N)
511	            woffs = torch.arange(win, device=x.device)
512	            qpos = torch.arange(N, device=x.device).unsqueeze(1)
513	            win_idx = qpos - woffs.unsqueeze(0)                      # [N, win]
514	            win_valid = win_idx >= 0
515	            win_idx_c = win_idx.clamp(min=0)
516	            win_kh = self._split_heads(k_tok)[:, win_idx_c, :]      # [H, N, win, hd]
517	            win_vh = self._split_heads(v_tok)[:, win_idx_c, :]
518	            win_scores = torch.einsum('hnd,hnwd->hnw', qh, win_kh) * scale
519	            win_scores = win_scores.masked_fill(
520	                ~win_valid.unsqueeze(0), float('-inf'))
521	
522	            all_scores = torch.cat([comp_scores, win_scores], dim=-1)  # [H,N,Nh+win]
523	            attn = torch.softmax(all_scores, dim=-1)
524	            attn_c = attn[:, :, :nh]                                  # [H, N, Nh]
525	            attn_w = attn[:, :, nh:]                                  # [H, N, win]
526	            ctx_h = (torch.einsum('hnm,hmd->hnd', attn_c, c_vh)
527	                     + torch.einsum('hnw,hnwd->hnd', attn_w, win_vh))  # [H, N, hd]
528	            ctx = ctx_h.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(N, d)
529	            return ctx
530	
531	        body = _csa_body if self.mode == 'csa' else _hca_body
532	        ctx = _maybe_checkpoint_fn(
533	            body, self.grad_checkpoint, self.training, x, q, k_tok, v_tok)
534	        return self.out_W(ctx)

537	class MiniGRU(nn.Module):
538	    """Tiny per-element GRU for temporal memory across optimizer steps."""
539	
540	    def __init__(self, input_dim: int, hidden_dim: int = 4,
541	                 grad_checkpoint: bool = True):
542	        super().__init__()
543	        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
544	        self.grad_checkpoint = grad_checkpoint
545	        self.W_z = nn.Linear(input_dim + hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
546	        self.W_r = nn.Linear(input_dim + hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
547	        self.W_h = nn.Linear(input_dim + hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
548	
549	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, h: torch.Tensor):
550	        def _gru_body(x, h):
551	            xh = torch.cat([x, h], dim=-1)
552	            z = torch.sigmoid(self.W_z(xh))
553	            r = torch.sigmoid(self.W_r(xh))
554	            xrh = torch.cat([x, r * h], dim=-1)
555	            h_tilde = torch.tanh(self.W_h(xrh))
556	            h_new = (1 - z) * h + z * h_tilde
557	            return h_new
558	
559	        return _maybe_checkpoint_fn(
560	            _gru_body, self.grad_checkpoint, self.training, x, h)

563	class CSAHCAMetaNet(nn.Module):
564	    """CSA/HCA Hybrid Attention + 4-Head PEER + Per-Element GRU meta-network.
565	
566	    The sequence mixer is a DeepSeek-V4-style pair of compressed attention
567	    blocks (CSA + HCA) replacing the previous bidirectional Mamba-3 scan. The
568	    GRU + PEER routing + expert MLP + Adam apply tail are unchanged.
569	    """
570	
571	    def __init__(
572	        self,
573	        d_model: int = 8,
574	        d_state: int = 16,             # retained for back-compat config (unused by attn)
575	        mamba_expand: int = 2,         # retained for back-compat config (unused by attn)
576	        num_peer_heads: int = 4,
577	        peer_topk: int = 4,
578	        num_experts: int = 144,
579	        expert_hidden: int = 16,
580	        gru_hidden: int = 4,
581	        rescale: float = 0.1,
582	        recycle_interval: int = 100,
583	        recycle_threshold: float = 0.001,
584	        # CSA/HCA attention config
585	        n_heads: int = 2,
586	        csa_compress: int = 4,
587	        csa_window: int = 8,
588	        csa_topk: int = 16,
589	        hca_compress: int = 128,
590	        indexer_rank: int = 4,
591	        grad_checkpoint: bool = True,
592	    ):
593	        super().__init__()
594	        self.grad_checkpoint = grad_checkpoint
595	        self.d_model = d_model
596	        self.d_state = d_state
597	        self.num_peer_heads = num_peer_heads
598	        # PEER routing top-k experts per head (spec §2). 4 is the design
599	        # default (4 product-key sub-selections per A/B axis → top-k soft
600	        # routing); 1 reproduces the old hard argmax (top-1) routing.

600	        # routing); 1 reproduces the old hard argmax (top-1) routing.
601	        self.peer_topk = max(1, int(peer_topk))
602	        self.num_experts = num_experts
603	        self.expert_hidden = expert_hidden
604	        self.gru_hidden = gru_hidden
605	        self.rescale = rescale
606	        self.recycle_interval = recycle_interval
607	        self.recycle_threshold = recycle_threshold
608	
609	        # CSA/HCA attention config
610	        self.n_heads = n_heads
611	        self.csa_compress = csa_compress
612	        self.csa_window = csa_window
613	        self.csa_topk = csa_topk
614	        self.hca_compress = hca_compress
615	        self.indexer_rank = indexer_rank
616	
617	        self.pk_dim = int(math.sqrt(num_experts))
618	        assert self.pk_dim * self.pk_dim == num_experts, \
619	            f"num_experts must be perfect square, got {num_experts}"
620	
621	        self.input_proj = nn.Linear(2, d_model, bias=True)
622	        # Sequence mixer: CSA (fine/local) + HCA (global/coarse) attention.
623	        self.csa_layer = HybridCompressedAttention(
624	            d_model, mode='csa', num_heads=n_heads,
625	            csa_compress=csa_compress, csa_window=csa_window, csa_topk=csa_topk,
626	            hca_compress=hca_compress, indexer_rank=indexer_rank,
627	            grad_checkpoint=grad_checkpoint,
628	        )
629	        self.hca_layer = HybridCompressedAttention(
630	            d_model, mode='hca', num_heads=n_heads,
631	            csa_compress=csa_compress, csa_window=csa_window, csa_topk=csa_topk,
632	            hca_compress=hca_compress, indexer_rank=indexer_rank,
633	            grad_checkpoint=grad_checkpoint,
634	        )
635	
636	        gru_input_dim = 2 + 2 * d_model
637	        self.gru = MiniGRU(gru_input_dim, gru_hidden,
638	                           grad_checkpoint=grad_checkpoint)
639	
640	        peer_input_dim = gru_hidden + 2 * d_model + 2
641	        self.peer_queries = nn.ModuleList([
642	            nn.Linear(peer_input_dim, d_model, bias=False)
643	            for _ in range(num_peer_heads)
644	        ])
645	        self.product_keys_A = nn.ParameterList([
646	            nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.pk_dim, d_model // 2) * 0.02)
647	            for _ in range(num_peer_heads)
648	        ])
649	        self.product_keys_B = nn.ParameterList([
650	            nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.pk_dim, d_model // 2) * 0.02)
651	            for _ in range(num_peer_heads)
652	        ])
653	
654	        self.expert_W1 = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_experts, expert_hidden, 1) * 0.02)
655	        self.expert_b1 = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_experts, expert_hidden))
656	        self.expert_W2 = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_experts, 1, expert_hidden) * 0.02)
657	        self.expert_b2 = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_experts, 1))
658	
659	        self.register_buffer('expert_counts', torch.zeros(num_experts, dtype=torch.int32))
660	        self.register_buffer('step_counter', torch.tensor(0, dtype=torch.long))

662	    def forward(
663	        self,
664	        grad: torch.Tensor,
665	        sharpness: torch.Tensor,
666	        gru_state: torch.Tensor,
667	        mamba_fwd_state: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
668	        mamba_bwd_state: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
669	    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
670	        # NOTE: mamba_fwd_state / mamba_bwd_state are accepted for signature
671	        # back-compat but ignored — CSA/HCA attention is stateless across steps.
672	        N = grad.numel()
673	        g = grad.reshape(-1).float()
674	        s = sharpness.reshape(-1).float()
675	
676	        sort_idx = g.abs().argsort()
677	        g_sorted = g[sort_idx]
678	        s_sorted = s[sort_idx]
679	
680	        inp = torch.stack([g_sorted, s_sorted], dim=-1)
681	        x = self.input_proj(inp)
682	
683	        # CSA → fine/local context; HCA → global/coarse context (both on |g|-sorted x).
684	        csa_out = self.csa_layer(x)
685	        hca_out = self.hca_layer(x)
686	
687	        unsort_idx = sort_idx.argsort()
688	        csa_ctx = csa_out[unsort_idx]
689	        hca_ctx = hca_out[unsort_idx]
690	
691	        gru_input = torch.cat([
692	            g.unsqueeze(-1), s.unsqueeze(-1),
693	            csa_ctx, hca_ctx
694	        ], dim=-1)
695	        new_gru = self.gru(gru_input, gru_state.float())
696	
697	        peer_input = torch.cat([
698	            new_gru, csa_ctx, hca_ctx,
699	            g.unsqueeze(-1), s.unsqueeze(-1)
700	        ], dim=-1)
701	
702	        total_expert_out = torch.zeros(N, 1, device=grad.device, dtype=torch.float32)
703	        topk = self.peer_topk
704	
705	        for h in range(self.num_peer_heads):
706	            query = self.peer_queries[h](peer_input)
707	            q_a = query[:, :self.d_model // 2]
708	            q_b = query[:, self.d_model // 2:]
709	
710	            scores_a = q_a @ self.product_keys_A[h].T
711	            scores_b = q_b @ self.product_keys_B[h].T
712	
713	            # Top-k product-key selection (spec §2). top-k=1 reduces to the old
714	            # hard argmax routing; the default top-k=4 keeps 4 sub-selections on
715	            # each axis and softmax-weights the k*k experts they index.
716	            ka = min(topk, scores_a.shape[-1])
717	            kb = min(topk, scores_b.shape[-1])
718	            top_a_vals, top_a_idx = scores_a.topk(ka, dim=-1)
719	            top_b_vals, top_b_idx = scores_b.topk(kb, dim=-1)
720	
721	            soft_a = torch.softmax(top_a_vals * 10.0, dim=-1)
722	            soft_b = torch.softmax(top_b_vals * 10.0, dim=-1)
723	
724	            expert_idx = (top_a_idx.unsqueeze(2) * self.pk_dim
725	                          + top_b_idx.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(N, -1)
726	            routing_weights = (soft_a.unsqueeze(2)
727	                               * soft_b.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(N, -1)
728	            num_active = ka * kb
729	
730	            if self.training:
731	                with torch.no_grad():
732	                    self.expert_counts.scatter_add_(
733	                        0, expert_idx.reshape(-1),
734	                        torch.ones(expert_idx.numel(),
735	                                   dtype=torch.int32, device=expert_idx.device))
736	
737	            W1 = self.expert_W1[expert_idx]
738	            b1 = self.expert_b1[expert_idx]
739	            W2 = self.expert_W2[expert_idx]
740	            b2 = self.expert_b2[expert_idx]
741	
742	            g_exp = g.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1).expand(
743	                -1, num_active, -1, -1)
744	            z = torch.relu(torch.matmul(W1, g_exp).squeeze(-1) + b1)
745	            out = (torch.matmul(W2, z.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1)
746	                   + b2.squeeze(-1))
747	            head_out = (routing_weights * out).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
748	            total_expert_out = total_expert_out + head_out
749	
750	        total_expert_out = total_expert_out / self.num_peer_heads
751	        smart_grad = (g.unsqueeze(-1) + self.rescale * total_expert_out).squeeze(-1)
752	        smart_grad = smart_grad.reshape(grad.shape).to(grad.dtype)
753	
754	        # Attention is stateless: return None for the (legacy) scan states.
755	        return smart_grad, new_gru, None, None

757	    def forward_for_bilevel(
758	        self, grad, sharpness, gru_state,
759	        mamba_fwd_state=None, mamba_bwd_state=None,
760	    ):
761	        """Differentiable forward with top-k sparse soft PEER routing."""
762	        N = grad.numel()
763	        g = grad.reshape(-1).float()
764	        s = sharpness.reshape(-1).float()
765	
766	        sort_idx = g.abs().argsort()
767	        g_sorted = g[sort_idx]
768	        s_sorted = s[sort_idx]
769	
770	        inp = torch.stack([g_sorted, s_sorted], dim=-1)
771	        x = self.input_proj(inp)
772	
773	        # CSA → fine/local context; HCA → global/coarse context (stateless).
774	        csa_out = self.csa_layer(x)
775	        hca_out = self.hca_layer(x)
776	
777	        unsort_idx = sort_idx.argsort()
778	        csa_ctx = csa_out[unsort_idx]
779	        hca_ctx = hca_out[unsort_idx]
780	
781	        gru_input = torch.cat([g.unsqueeze(-1), s.unsqueeze(-1), csa_ctx, hca_ctx], dim=-1)
782	        new_gru = self.gru(gru_input, gru_state.float())
783	
784	        peer_input = torch.cat([new_gru, csa_ctx, hca_ctx, g.unsqueeze(-1), s.unsqueeze(-1)], dim=-1)
785	
786	        total_expert_out = torch.zeros(N, 1, device=grad.device, dtype=torch.float32)
787	        topk = self.peer_topk
788	
789	        for h in range(self.num_peer_heads):
790	            query = self.peer_queries[h](peer_input)
791	            q_a = query[:, :self.d_model // 2]
792	            q_b = query[:, self.d_model // 2:]
793	
794	            scores_a = q_a @ self.product_keys_A[h].T
795	            scores_b = q_b @ self.product_keys_B[h].T
796	
797	            ka = min(topk, scores_a.shape[-1])
798	            kb = min(topk, scores_b.shape[-1])
799	            top_a_vals, top_a_idx = scores_a.topk(ka, dim=-1)
800	            top_b_vals, top_b_idx = scores_b.topk(kb, dim=-1)
801	
802	            soft_a = torch.softmax(top_a_vals * 10.0, dim=-1)
803	            soft_b = torch.softmax(top_b_vals * 10.0, dim=-1)
804	
805	            expert_indices = (top_a_idx.unsqueeze(2) * self.pk_dim + top_b_idx.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(N, -1)
806	            routing_weights = (soft_a.unsqueeze(2) * soft_b.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(N, -1)
807	
808	            W1 = self.expert_W1[expert_indices]
809	            b1 = self.expert_b1[expert_indices]
810	            W2 = self.expert_W2[expert_indices]
811	            b2 = self.expert_b2[expert_indices]
812	
813	            num_active = ka * kb
814	
815	            # Per-head expert MLP (the two batched matmuls + relu) is the
816	            # largest self-contained sub-block here; checkpoint it so the
817	            # [N, num_active, ...] activations are recomputed in backward.
818	            def _expert_mlp(g, W1, b1, W2, b2, routing_weights):
819	                g_exp = g.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, num_active, -1, -1)
820	                z = torch.relu(torch.matmul(W1, g_exp).squeeze(-1) + b1)
821	                out = torch.matmul(W2, z.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1) + b2.squeeze(-1)
822	                return (routing_weights * out).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
823	
824	            head_out = _maybe_checkpoint_fn(
825	                _expert_mlp, self.grad_checkpoint, self.training,
826	                g, W1, b1, W2, b2, routing_weights)
827	            total_expert_out = total_expert_out + head_out
828	
829	        total_expert_out = total_expert_out / self.num_peer_heads
830	        smart_grad = (g.unsqueeze(-1) + self.rescale * total_expert_out).squeeze(-1)
831	        # Attention is stateless: return None for the (legacy) scan states.
832	        return smart_grad.reshape(grad.shape).to(grad.dtype), new_gru, None, None

834	    @torch.no_grad()
835	    def _recycle_dead_experts(self):
836	        """Replace dead experts with mutated clones of top performers."""
837	        total_activations = self.expert_counts.sum().item()
838	        if total_activations == 0:
839	            return
840	
841	        fractions = self.expert_counts.float() / total_activations
842	        dead_mask = fractions < self.recycle_threshold
843	
844	        if not dead_mask.any():
845	            self.expert_counts.zero_()
846	            return
847	
848	        counts_f = self.expert_counts.float()
849	        # Keep the sampled donor expert as a 0-d device tensor (no .item()
850	        # host sync); advanced indexing with it stays on device.
851	        top_expert = torch.multinomial(counts_f, 1)[0]
852	        dead_indices = dead_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
853	
854	        noise_scale = 0.01
855	        # Vectorized expert mutation: gather every dead row in one shot,
856	        # generate all the perturbation noise with a single randn_like per
857	        # tensor, and scatter back — replaces the per-index Python loop and
858	        # its per-iteration .item()/randn_like calls.
859	        for buf in (self.expert_W1, self.expert_b1,
860	                    self.expert_W2, self.expert_b2):
861	            donor = buf.data[top_expert].unsqueeze(0)  # [1, ...]
862	            slice_ = buf.data[dead_indices]
863	            buf.data[dead_indices] = donor + noise_scale * torch.randn_like(
864	                slice_)
865	
866	        # Product-key recycling: a query/key row is reset only when *all* of
867	        # its experts are dead. Compute those conditions in a vectorized,
868	        # on-device fashion (per (a_idx,b_idx) group) instead of inside the
869	        # per-dead-expert Python loop. The boolean reductions below stay as
870	        # device tensors and are only realised by the indexed assignment.
871	        if self.num_experts % self.pk_dim == 0:
872	            num_a = self.num_experts // self.pk_dim
873	            # dead_mask reshaped to [num_a, pk_dim]: rows index a_idx, cols b_idx
874	            dm2d = dead_mask[:num_a * self.pk_dim].reshape(num_a, self.pk_dim)
875	            dead_rows = dm2d.all(dim=1).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]   # a_idx fully dead
876	            dead_cols = dm2d.all(dim=0).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]   # b_idx fully dead
877	            if dead_rows.numel() > 0:
878	                for h in range(self.num_peer_heads):
879	                    sel = self.product_keys_A[h].data[dead_rows]
880	                    self.product_keys_A[h].data[dead_rows] = \
881	                        torch.randn_like(sel) * 0.02
882	            if dead_cols.numel() > 0:
883	                for h in range(self.num_peer_heads):
884	                    sel = self.product_keys_B[h].data[dead_cols]
885	                    self.product_keys_B[h].data[dead_cols] = \
886	                        torch.randn_like(sel) * 0.02
887	        else:
888	            # Fallback (ragged num_experts): preserve the original per-dead
889	            # logic exactly, including its row/col .all() semantics.
890	            for idx in dead_indices:
891	                i = int(idx)
892	                a_idx = i // self.pk_dim
893	                b_idx = i % self.pk_dim
894	                row_start = a_idx * self.pk_dim
895	                row_end = row_start + self.pk_dim
896	                if dead_mask[row_start:row_end].all():
897	                    for h in range(self.num_peer_heads):
898	                        self.product_keys_A[h].data[a_idx] = torch.randn_like(
899	                            self.product_keys_A[h].data[a_idx]) * 0.02
900	                col_indices = torch.arange(0, self.num_experts, self.pk_dim,
901	                                           device=dead_mask.device) + b_idx
902	                col_indices = col_indices[col_indices < self.num_experts]
903	                if dead_mask[col_indices].all():
904	                    for h in range(self.num_peer_heads):
905	                        self.product_keys_B[h].data[b_idx] = torch.randn_like(
906	                            self.product_keys_B[h].data[b_idx]) * 0.02
907	
908	        self.expert_counts.zero_()

915	    def forward_for_bilevel_cuda(
916	        self, grad, sharpness, gru_state,
917	        mamba_fwd_state=None, mamba_bwd_state=None,
918	    ):
919	        """Bilevel forward with saved intermediates for the C++ backward.
920	
921	        Runs the full meta-net forward under torch.no_grad(), saving the
922	        activation tensors the C++ bilevel_backward_driver needs. Returns
923	        (smart_grad, new_gru_state, saved_dict).
924	        """
925	        N = grad.numel()
926	        g = grad.reshape(-1).float()
927	        s = sharpness.reshape(-1).float()
928	
929	        sort_idx = g.abs().argsort()
930	        g_sorted = g[sort_idx]
931	        s_sorted = s[sort_idx]
932	
933	        inp = torch.stack([g_sorted, s_sorted], dim=-1)
934	        x = self.input_proj(inp)
935	
936	        csa_out = self.csa_layer(x)
937	        hca_out = self.hca_layer(x)
938	
939	        unsort_idx = sort_idx.argsort()
940	        csa_ctx = csa_out[unsort_idx]
941	        hca_ctx = hca_out[unsort_idx]
942	
943	        gru_input = torch.cat([g.unsqueeze(-1), s.unsqueeze(-1),
944	                               csa_ctx, hca_ctx], dim=-1)
945	        h_old = gru_state.float()
946	        if h_old.dim() == 1:
947	            h_old = h_old.unsqueeze(0).expand(N, -1).contiguous()
948	        xh = torch.cat([gru_input, h_old], dim=-1)
949	        gru_z = torch.sigmoid(self.gru.W_z(xh))
950	        gru_r = torch.sigmoid(self.gru.W_r(xh))
951	        xrh = torch.cat([gru_input, gru_r * h_old], dim=-1)
952	        gru_h_tilde = torch.tanh(self.gru.W_h(xrh))
953	        new_gru = (1.0 - gru_z) * h_old + gru_z * gru_h_tilde
954	
955	        peer_input = torch.cat([new_gru, csa_ctx, hca_ctx,
956	                                g.unsqueeze(-1), s.unsqueeze(-1)], dim=-1)
957	
958	        total_expert_out = torch.zeros(N, 1, device=grad.device,
959	                                       dtype=torch.float32)
960	        topk = self.peer_topk
961	        for h in range(self.num_peer_heads):
962	            query = self.peer_queries[h](peer_input)
963	            q_a = query[:, :self.d_model // 2]
964	            q_b = query[:, self.d_model // 2:]
965	            scores_a = q_a @ self.product_keys_A[h].T
966	            scores_b = q_b @ self.product_keys_B[h].T
967	            ka = min(topk, scores_a.shape[-1])
968	            kb = min(topk, scores_b.shape[-1])
969	            top_a_vals, top_a_idx = scores_a.topk(ka, dim=-1)
970	            top_b_vals, top_b_idx = scores_b.topk(kb, dim=-1)
971	            soft_a = torch.softmax(top_a_vals * 10.0, dim=-1)
972	            soft_b = torch.softmax(top_b_vals * 10.0, dim=-1)
973	            expert_indices = (top_a_idx.unsqueeze(2) * self.pk_dim
974	                              + top_b_idx.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(N, -1)
975	            routing_weights = (soft_a.unsqueeze(2)
976	                               * soft_b.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(N, -1)
977	            W1 = self.expert_W1[expert_indices]
978	            b1 = self.expert_b1[expert_indices]
979	            W2 = self.expert_W2[expert_indices]
980	            b2 = self.expert_b2[expert_indices]
981	            num_active = ka * kb
982	            g_exp = g.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1).expand(
983	                -1, num_active, -1, -1)
984	            z_h = torch.relu(torch.matmul(W1, g_exp).squeeze(-1) + b1)
985	            out = (torch.matmul(W2, z_h.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1)
986	                   + b2.squeeze(-1))
987	            head_out = (routing_weights * out).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
988	            total_expert_out = total_expert_out + head_out
989	
990	        total_expert_out = total_expert_out / self.num_peer_heads
991	        smart_grad = (g.unsqueeze(-1)
992	                      + self.rescale * total_expert_out).squeeze(-1)
993	        smart_grad = smart_grad.reshape(grad.shape).to(grad.dtype)
994	
995	        saved = {
996	            'sort_indices': sort_idx.detach(),
997	            'x_sorted': x.detach(),
998	            'csa_ctx': csa_ctx.detach(),
999	            'hca_ctx': hca_ctx.detach(),
1000	            'gru_input': gru_input.detach(),
1001	            'gru_h_old': h_old.detach(),
1002	            'gru_z': gru_z.detach(),
1003	            'gru_r': gru_r.detach(),
1004	            'gru_h_tilde': gru_h_tilde.detach(),
1005	            'peer_input': peer_input.detach(),
1006	        }
1007	        return smart_grad, new_gru.detach(), saved

1009	    def get_weights(self, precision=None):
1010	        """Extract all meta-model weights for the CUDA/HIP kernels.
1011	
1012	        Returns the CSA/HCA weight set (spec §4): the Mamba scan weights are
1013	        dropped and replaced by the CSA + HCA attention projections. The shared
1014	        input_proj, GRU, PEER/product-key, and expert tensors are kept.
1015	
1016	        Precision (spec §1):
1017	          ``precision`` is an optional :class:`PrecisionConfig`. When ``None``
1018	          (or ``projection_precision`` resolves to ``fp32``/``tf32``), every
1019	          tensor is detached, FP32, contiguous — the historical behaviour that
1020	          the FP32 kernel ABI consumes directly.
1021	
1022	          When ``projection_precision == 'bf16'`` (the live SG2 default) the
1023	          attention *projection* matrices (input_proj, CSA/HCA q/k/v/out,
1024	          indexer DQ/UQ/K) are emitted in BF16 via
1025	          :meth:`PrecisionConfig.convert_projection_weights`; ``'fp8'`` emits
1026	          FP8 with a per-matrix ``<name>_scale`` companion. Compress logits,
1027	          GRU, PEER queries, product keys, biases and the scan-free scalars stay
1028	          FP32 (they are accumulators / tiny vectors, not GEMM operands). Expert
1029	          MLP weights follow ``expert_precision`` (int8/int4 emit packed tensors
1030	          + scales) — these are reachable, config-gated paths, not dead code.
1031	
1032	        The emitted-dtype tensors are what the step() call site forwards to the
1033	        kernel. See the ``_KERNEL_PROJECTION_DTYPE_ABI`` note in
1034	        :meth:`SuperGrok2.step` for the documented C++ ABI dependency: the
1035	        current ``supergrok2_*_step`` pybind signature is ``const float*`` for
1036	        every projection weight, so the live fused tail upcasts the emitted
1037	        low-precision tensors back to FP32 at that boundary until the bf16/fp8
1038	        kernel overloads land. The bf16 *emission* path is fully reachable and
1039	        is the dtype the eager / autograd meta-net consumes natively.
1040	        """
1041	        proj_mode = (precision.projection_precision
1042	                     if precision is not None else 'fp32')
1043	        expert_mode = (precision.expert_precision
1044	                       if precision is not None else 'fp32')
1045	
1046	        def _f32(t):
1047	            return t.detach().float().contiguous()
1048	
1049	        def _proj(t):
1050	            """Emit a projection matrix at the configured precision.
1051	
1052	            Returns (tensor, scale|None). FP32/TF32 → fp32 tensor, None.
1053	            BF16 → bf16 tensor, None. FP8 → fp8 tensor + scalar scale.
1054	            """
1055	            if precision is None or proj_mode in ('fp32', 'tf32'):
1056	                return _f32(t), None
1057	            return precision.convert_projection_weights(t.detach())
1058	
1059	        out = {}
1060	
1061	        def _put_proj(name, t):
1062	            w, scale = _proj(t)
1063	            out[name] = w
1064	            if scale is not None:
1065	                out[name + '_scale'] = scale
1066	
1067	        # ── shared input projection ──
1068	        _put_proj('input_proj_W', self.input_proj.weight)
1069	        out['input_proj_b'] = _f32(self.input_proj.bias)
1070	        # ── CSA layer (produces csa_ctx) ──
1071	        _put_proj('csa_q_W', self.csa_layer.q_W.weight)
1072	        _put_proj('csa_k_W', self.csa_layer.k_W.weight)
1073	        _put_proj('csa_v_W', self.csa_layer.v_W.weight)
1074	        out['csa_compress_w'] = _f32(self.csa_layer.compress_w)

1447	    def _sigmoid(self, scale, value, thresh):
1448	        return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-scale * (value - thresh)))

1450	    def _update_alpha(self, train_loss, val_loss, train_acc):
1451	        if train_loss is None and train_acc is None:
1452	            return
1453	        signal = 0.0
1454	        memorized = False
1455	        if train_acc is not None and train_acc >= self.zero_acc_threshold:
1456	            memorized = True
1457	        elif train_loss is not None and train_loss < self.zero_loss_threshold:
1458	            memorized = True
1459	        if memorized:
1460	            signal = 10.0
1461	        elif val_loss is not None and train_loss is not None and train_loss > 1e-12:
1462	            signal = max(0.0, (val_loss - train_loss) / train_loss)
1463	        self._cached_alpha = self.alpha_init * math.exp(-self.kappa * signal)

1465	    def _get_ramp_factor(self):
1466	        step = self._global_step
1467	        if step <= self.warmup_steps:
1468	            return 0.0
1469	        elapsed = step - self.warmup_steps
1470	        return min(1.0, elapsed / self.warmup_ramp)

1474	        sigmoid_val = self._sigmoid(self.wd_scale, acc, self.wd_thresh)
1475	        return base_wd * (1.0 + self.wd_ramp * sigmoid_val)

1483	        acc = self._cached_train_acc
1484	        sam_heat = self._sigmoid(self.sam_scale, acc, self.sam_thresh)
1485	        freq = self.sam_freq_max - (self.sam_freq_max - self.sam_freq_min) * sam_heat

1498	    def _allreduce_meta_grads(self):
1499	        """All-reduce meta-net gradients across ranks for consistent updates."""
1500	        if not self._is_distributed():

1609	    def sam_step(self, model, train_x, train_y, criterion):
1610	        """SAM ascent step → per-parameter sharpness |g(w+e) − g(w)|.
1611	
1612	        Recomputes the gradient at the SAM-perturbed point e(w)=rho·g/‖g‖ via
1613	        ``torch.func.functional_call`` and writes the elementwise sharpness into
1614	        ``_flat_sharpness`` (the buffer the meta-net's 2nd input and the fused
1615	        kernel read). Mirrors the SuperGrok11 fix — the previous version was
1616	        broken on **every** call (silently: the race loop swallows the exception),
1617	        so SG2 ran with NO SAM signal, and because it ``model.zero_grad()``'d and
1618	        then raised, it also left the params grad-less → starved ``bilevel_step``
1619	        (the only meta-net trainer) of gradients. Two correctness points:
1620	          • the perturbed params come from ``.detach()`` so they must be
1621	            ``.requires_grad_(True)`` or autograd has nothing to differentiate
1622	            (the old ``sam_loss.backward()`` raised "element 0 … does not require
1623	            grad" every time);
1624	          • ``functional_call`` substitutes the perturbed tensors as the module's
1625	            params, so gradients live on THEM — take them with ``autograd.grad``
1626	            and leave each ``p.grad`` (the original backward result ``step()``
1627	            and ``bilevel_step`` consume) completely untouched (no zero_grad).
1628	        Sharpness is flattened to ``(numel,)`` to match its ``torch.zeros(N)`` init.
1629	        """
1630	        self._ensure_state()
1631	        train_grads = {}
1632	        for name, p in model.named_parameters():
1633	            if p.grad is not None:
1634	                train_grads[name] = p.grad.detach().clone()
1635	        if not train_grads:
1636	            return 0.0
1637	
1638	        flat_grads = [train_grads[n] for n, _ in model.named_parameters() if n in train_grads]
1639	        total_norm_sq = sum(g.norm().pow(2) for g in flat_grads if g.numel() > 0)
1640	        grad_norm = total_norm_sq.sqrt() + 1e-12
1641	        rho_over_norm = self.sam_rho / grad_norm
1642	
1643	        named_params = dict(model.named_parameters())
1644	        pert_names = [n for n in named_params if n in train_grads]
1645	        perturbed = {}
1646	        for name, p in named_params.items():
1647	            if name in train_grads:
1648	                perturbed[name] = (p.detach() + rho_over_norm * train_grads[name]).requires_grad_(True)
1649	            else:
1650	                perturbed[name] = p.detach()
1651	
1652	        with torch.enable_grad():
1653	            sam_logits = torch.func.functional_call(model, perturbed, (train_x,))
1654	            sam_loss = criterion(sam_logits, train_y)
1655	            sam_grads = torch.autograd.grad(
1656	                sam_loss, [perturbed[n] for n in pert_names], allow_unused=True)
1657	        sam_loss_val = sam_loss.item()
1658	
1659	        for name, sg in zip(pert_names, sam_grads):
1660	            if sg is None:
1661	                continue
1662	            pidx = self._param_to_idx.get(id(named_params[name]))
1663	            if pidx is not None:
1664	                self._flat_sharpness[pidx] = (sg.detach() - train_grads[name]).abs().reshape(-1)
1665	
1666	        return sam_loss_val

1671	        PURE L3-TC (owner directive): the C++ hand-written VJP backward
1672	        (``_bilevel_step_cuda`` → ``_ops.supergrok2_bilevel_backward``) was DROPPED;
1673	        this host-side meta-net training now ALWAYS uses the ``torch.autograd``
1674	        path (``_bilevel_step_autograd``). The meta-net it trains is then evaluated
1675	        IN the megakernel (fused_train_step scatters its weights). The model
1676	        forward/backward + optimizer update never run eager here.
1677	        """
1678	        self._ensure_state()

1680	
1681	        saved_grads = {}
1682	        for name, p in named_params:
1683	            if p.grad is not None:
1684	                saved_grads[name] = p.grad.detach().clone()

1691	
1692	        param_info = []
1693	        for name, p in named_params:
1694	            if name not in saved_grads:
1695	                continue
1696	            pidx = self._param_to_idx.get(id(p))
1697	            if pidx is None:
1698	                continue
1699	            grad_flat = saved_grads[name].reshape(-1).float().contiguous()
1700	            sharp_flat = self._flat_sharpness[pidx].reshape(-1).float().contiguous()

1704	
1705	        if not param_info:

1707	            # (or every mapped grad is 0-element). Return a 0-d zero loss so the
1708	            # caller can accumulate it uniformly with the real return paths
1709	            # (which return ``val_loss.detach()``). Place it on the device of any
1710	            # saved grad when one exists, else CPU. (The previous
1711	            # ``saved_grads and ... or 'cpu'`` and/or idiom was precedence-
1712	            # fragile and keyed the device off saved_grads rather than this

1714	            if saved_grads:
1715	                dev = next(iter(saved_grads.values())).device
1716	            else:
1717	                dev = torch.device('cpu')

1719	
1720	        # PURE L3-TC: the C++ bilevel backward (_bilevel_step_cuda) is DROPPED;
1721	        # always use the autograd path. (mn.has_cuda_bilevel is no longer consulted.)
1722	        return self._bilevel_step_autograd(
1723	            model, val_x, val_y, criterion, meta_optimizer,
1724	            named_params, saved_grads, param_info, mn)
